The '''SnapShoot DT3''' was a [[quick-draw pulse-wave blaster]] manufactured by [[Greff-Timms Industrial/Legends|Greff-Timms Industrial]]. It cost 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], had an ammunition capacity of only 3 shots, and a range of 10 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="TotJC" />
